name: Travel.pk Best-Time-to-Book DEMO dataset (SIMULATED - not real airline data)
source_description: Generated locally by data/generate_demo_data.py using a seeded random simulation. No external provider, API or website was used.
geographic_coverage: Pakistan domestic, one-way: LHE→KHI, KHI→LHE, LHE→ISB, ISB→LHE, KHI→ISB, ISB→KHI (these routes exist only as simulated rows).
observation_semantics: Each row is one simulated fare snapshot for one simulated itinerary (route + carrier + departure date), as if observed on observation_date. Each itinerary has 10 snapshots at different lead times.

field_definitions.carrier: Generic placeholder carrier name (not a real airline).
field_definitions.fare: Simulated one-way fare in whole PKR.
field_definitions.currency: ISO-4217 code; all rows are PKR.

provenance: All fares are random draws from formulas whose parameters (base fare, seasonality, weekday effect, last-minute premium, route-specific cheapest lead time, noise) are illustrative assumptions by the developer. They are not estimates of real fares, airlines or traveller behaviour. Carrier names are generic placeholders.
limitations: Booking-window patterns in this dataset are produced by the simulation's own assumptions, so any recommendation demonstrates the method only.
Departures cover calendar year 2025 only; observations start up to 90 days earlier.
ISB→KHI in February and KHI→ISB in January are deliberately thin/missing to exercise the app's insufficient-data and empty-data states.
Every itinerary has snapshots in every booking window by construction, unlike real scrapes.
license: Generated data, free to use and replace.
